Messages.Author: Uriel
Messages.Body:
1. Vamp A bleeds, Vamp B blocks. Before A plays any action modifiers
(to increase stealth) can B play obedience (since they're about to
enter combat)?

2. Vamp A bleeds, Vamp B blocks. A plays majesty superior and untaps.
B plays superior Psyche! and restarts combat. Can A (the original
acting minion) play Obedience?

Thanks for the clarifications.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Uriel wrote:
>
> 1. Vamp A bleeds, Vamp B blocks. Before A plays any action modifiers
> (to increase stealth) can B play obedience (since they're about to
> enter combat)?

No, since they're not about to enter combat - that ('tap and enter combat')
won't happen until the block succeeds.

> 2. Vamp A bleeds, Vamp B blocks. A plays majesty superior and untaps.
> B plays superior Psyche! and restarts combat. Can A (the original
> acting minion) play Obedience?

Yes.
